lines.trans: That's it, I placed my bet.
Vitya, were you drinking all night?
I drank. I lost so much that I had to have a drink.
So you were gambling too?
Well, you are the one to blame for that.
You gave me that wretched elephant.
So I am to blame too?
Fine, when you come to your senses, we will talk.
Lena, well you aren't to blame, it's that elephant that I lost!

examples.text: Кухня закрывается, а вы с Катей остаётесь до последнего гостя.
examples.trans: The kitchen is closing, and you and Katya are staying until the last guest.

examples.text: Нагиев уже два дня Катину химию жрёт, ему недолго осталось.
examples.trans: Nagiyev has been eating Katya's chemicals for two days now, he doesn't have long left.

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'chemicals, chemistry' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Нагиев уже два дня Катину химию жрёт, ему недолго осталось.
examples.trans: Nagiyev has been eating Katya's chemicals for two days now, he doesn't have long left.

examples.text: Выкинь, это же химия!
examples.trans: Throw it out, that is pure chemicals!

examples.text: В школе мы учили химию.
examples.trans: At school we studied chemistry.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'gobbles, eats'.

examples.text: Жрать будешь ты.
examples.trans: You're eating this.

examples.text: Надо всё сделать и жрать вовремя.
examples.trans: We need to do everything and gobbles on time.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'to him', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Они бесцеремонны.
examples.trans: They are unceremonious.

examples.text: Занимайся своим делом, понял? Тогда сами переделывайте!
examples.trans: Mind your own business, got it? Then redo it yourselves!

examples.text: А почему ты слоника не носишь, который я тебе подарила?
examples.trans: And why aren't you carrying the little elephant that I gave you?

meanings.en: not for long, for a short time
meanings.note: Negative prefix 'не-' ('un-, non-, not') (stem 'долго'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Нагиев уже два дня Катину химию жрёт, ему недолго осталось.
examples.trans: Nagiyev has been eating Katya's chemicals for two days now, he doesn't have long left.

examples.text: Телевизор мне смотреть недолго.
examples.trans: I won't be watching TV for much longer.

examples.text: Мы поговорили недолго.
examples.trans: We talked briefly.

meanings.note: Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'remained', paired with 'оставаться'.

examples.text: Ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: There's nothing left.

examples.text: Я останусь дома.
examples.trans: I'll stay at home.

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.
